headline: Change ownership and the delivery base without voiding checks

V26-3251.title: Keep lane ownership and story lanes in the record

criteria.text: Moving a story or a file to another lane is one command, takes effect for the lane at once, and makes no base commit.
Two lanes each committing a refreshed provenance.lock.json are both accepted.
A row test shows that a lead ownership change made while a candidate checks leaves the check running.

V26-3253.title: Make lead changes that must touch the base wait for the merge slot

criteria.text: A lead push issued while a candidate checks lands after that check ends, and the check isn't voided.
A flake declared in the record during a check is retried by that check.

V26-3252.title: Let two lanes work in one large file at once

criteria.text: Two lanes can each be assigned a story editing different functions of one file, hand off, and be accepted.
Overlapping edits are caught before the second candidate's review round, not at the queue's sync.

V26-3403.title: Let a lane keep its review across a lead-directed base merge

criteria.text: A base merge carries the review. Reviewed head R, then only a merge of the base (no lane-owned file changed, same diff against the base): handoff at HEAD succeeds without a new round. The hand-off record names R, HEAD and the merged base commits.
A lane commit after R still needs a new round, with the existing message.
A merge that changes a lane-owned file still needs a new round, and the refusal names the file.
The queue's later carry is unchanged. lead-carry-review on a queued story behaves as it does today.
The brief explains it. It tells a lane that a lead-directed base merge keeps its review, and that it needs no carry request.

V26-3254.title: Make an integration base a supported delivery mode

criteria.text: A delivery set up with an integration base runs end to end, and the supervisor closes it with no hand edits to the binding.
The full suite passes on the integration base.

V26-3301.title: Switch the lead generation before a lane writes the record

criteria.text: A row writes the record with a newer generation's tool, before the lead upgrades, and is refused with both generations named and nothing written.
After the lead's upgrade, the same write succeeds.
The solution note names the symptom (state_invalid: … no value is allowed here right after a lane applies a release), the cause and the recovery.

V26-3255.title: Move a long-lived delivery base onto a newer default branch

criteria.text: A rebase or merge of a fixture delivery base onto a moved default branch, with lock-only conflicts, completes with one command.
Afterwards, every queue entry's merged SHA resolves in the new history.

finish.label: Every story
finish.text: All seven stories merged through the queue or closed with a recorded reason.

finish.label: Merged to main
finish.text: The reviewed integration lands on main.

finish.label: Final full health
finish.text: The full suite passes once at delivery close-out on the final integrated head on macOS with Python 3.11.

finish.label: Main CI
finish.text: Ubuntu and cut-release pass on the exact main integration push.

finish.label: Next release run
finish.text: Verify ownership transfer without a base push and that only the integration step needs a manual queue hold in a delivery run on the next approved release.

outOfScope: A distributed lock spanning machines and work from the related queue and tracker epics.
Force-moving remote refs, automatic conflict resolution for substantive source changes, and new forge or host integrations.
A release tag outside the repository's batch release process.
